sqlMap.select:
SELECT FROM ORDERS O
O.STATUS = #status#
O.MEMO LIKE '%' || #keyword# || '%'
O.AMOUNT >= #minAmount:NUMERIC#
#orderIds[]#
ORDER BY $sortColumn$ DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(O.ORDERED_AT, 'YYYY-MM') AS SALES_MONTH, COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT, NVL(SUM(O.AMOUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.ORDERED_AT >= TO_DATE(#fromDate#, 'YYYYMMDD') AND O.ORDERED_AT < TO_DATE(#toDate#, 'YYYYMMDD') AND O.STATUS <> 'CANCELLED' -- cancelled orders are not sales GROUP BY TO_CHAR(O.ORDERED_AT, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY SALES_MONTH
sqlMap.insert:
SELECT ORDER_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO ORDERS (ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, STATUS, AMOUNT, ORDERED_AT) VALUES (#orderId#, #customerId#, 'NEW', #amount:NUMERIC:0#, SYSDATE)
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ORDERS SET STATUS = #status,jdbcType=VARCHAR# WHERE ORDER_ID = #orderId#
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDERED_AT < ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -#months#)
